name: OpenTyrian2000
description:
OpenTyrian2000 is an open-source port of Tyrian 2000, the classic 1999 vertical scrolling shoot-em-up game. It updates the classic DOS game to run natively on modern operating systems with enhanced features.

Features:
- Full arcade-style vertical shooting gameplay across all five story episodes
- Deep ship customization system with shields, weapons, sidekicks, and generators
- Includes mini-games such as Destruct and the secret Super Tyrian modes
- Scalable graphics with multiple scaler options and widescreen borders
- Modern USB gamepad and joystick support alongside classic keyboard controls
